name: Send OpenCart order and delivery SMS notifications with RCSZilla

parameters.content:
## n8n OpenCart SMS notifications

This workflow receives OpenCart order status events, prepares a customer-friendly SMS update, checks phone and SMS consent, then queues the message through RCSZilla.

Use it for order confirmations, shipped notifications, out-for-delivery updates, delivered messages, canceled orders, failed payments, and refund updates.

## Setup Guide

1. Install community node: n8n-nodes-rcszilla.
2. Create RCSZilla credentials in n8n.
3. Activate this workflow and copy the production webhook URL.
4. If you only need standard OpenCart SMS, the official RCSZilla OpenCart plugin may be enough.
5. Use this n8n workflow when you need custom routing, logging, CRM updates, extra validation, or multi-step automation.
6. In OpenCart, use an order-status extension, event hook, or small custom module to POST order updates to this webhook.
7. Send a test payload with one internal phone number and sms_consent = true.
8. Confirm the skipped and queued webhook responses before using live orders.

## Webhook Payload

POST JSON to the webhook:

{
  "order_id": "12345",
  "order_status": "shipped",
  "first_name": "Maria",
  "telephone": "+40700000000",
  "sms_consent": true,
  "store_name": "Demo Store",
  "order_total": "129.00 RON",
  "shipping_method": "Courier",
  "tracking_number": "AWB123",
  "tracking_url": "https://tracking.example/AWB123",
  "channel": "sms"
}

The workflow also reads common alternatives such as phone, customer_phone, orderStatus, status, customer.firstname, customer.telephone, trackingNumber, and trackingUrl.

## Status Message Mapping

Supported statuses:

pending
processing
shipped
out_for_delivery
delivered
canceled
failed
refunded

Aliases are included for common values like complete, completed, dispatched, cancelled, and refund.

If your OpenCart store sends numeric status IDs, edit the statusAliases object in Prepare OpenCart SMS notification to map your IDs to these names.

## Compliance Notes

Send SMS only when the customer agreed to order updates by SMS.

This workflow requires sms_consent, transactional_sms_allowed, consent, or opt_in to be true. It also skips contacts marked sms_opt_out, opt_out, unsubscribe, or do_not_sms.

Keep Reply STOP to opt out in the message unless your legal process requires different wording.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, status: 'queued', orderId: $('Prepare OpenCart SMS notification').item.json.orderId, orderStatus: $('Prepare OpenCart SMS notification').item.json.orderStatus, referenceId: $('Prepare OpenCart SMS notification').item.json.referenceId, rcszilla: $json } }}
={{ { success: false, status: 'skipped', reason: $json.skipReason, orderId: $json.orderId, orderStatus: $json.orderStatus } }}
